text:
jessica: quick sync — product wants region-aware routing that also accounts for model-variant health and customer tier. they want an explanation in the console for why a request was routed to a non-primary region. any strong opinions?

sam: agree. two layers: choose region by latency probe + tier constraints, then select variant by compatibility + health score. if primary region latency is above tier-threshold -> fall back. keep it simple for first pass. :thumbsup:

mira: telemetry needs: per-request decision trace (region, variant, latencies at probe time), variant_health, cache_hit boolean. we should emit a compact decision vector so the console can display the why. also histogram of probe RTTs per-region per-model.

liam: quotas caveat — if we route too many fallbacks to a single region during an outage, we can blow that region's reserved capacity. propose per-tier backpressure: cap fallback QPS per-region and degrade to cheaper variant or increase batching.

anita: console UX thought: show a small decision bar under the request details: [region chosen] <- reason (latency/health/quota). let users expand to see the decision flags + the raw probe numbers. also add a "why-this-variant" modal.

sam: sketch of policy config (proposal):
```json
{
  "routing_order": ["latency", "variant_health", "tier_affinity", "quota_headroom"],
  "latency_threshold_ms": {"enterprise": 120, "standard": 220, "starter": 400},
  "variant_health_min": 0.95,
  "fallback_limit_per_region_per_min": {"enterprise": 1200, "standard": 600, "starter": 100}
}
```

jessica: nice. a few implementation Qs: how do we compute "latency"? last-probe vs smoothed p95? and who owns the probe — routing service or regional edge?

mira: recommend smoothed p95 from short window (1m) at edge + real-time probe before routing if smoothed_p95 > threshold. that gives a cheap estimate and a final confirm. emit both numbers to telemetry.

liam: also need to mark variants as "probational" during rollout so traffic to new quantized variant is limited by both tier and region headroom. otherwise we can cause regressions when fallback routes traffic to an unproven variant.

anita: for console rollout controls: show a per-region slider for canary percentage and an override that pins a tenant to a region+variant. UI should warn if override violates SLA.

deploy-bot: deploy started: region-routing-service v3.4-canary -> 3 instances in us-west2, 2 instances in eu-central. rollout id: rr-2024-11-12-02

mira: final ask for telemetry schema before we start building UI: fields: request_id, routed_region, chosen_variant, smoothed_p95_ms, probe_rtt_ms, variant_health, fallback_reason (enum), tier, region_capacity_headroom. keep names stable.

jessica: perfect. next steps: sam to draft policy protobuf, mira to define telemetry schema, liam to propose quota backpressure thresholds, anita to wire UI mockups. aim for RFC next Thurs. :rocket:
